1. HULL IDENTITY DOES NOT EXIST. The two 3-hulls are stored in canonical index order (idx3a < idx3b), so slot membership is not stable across branches — the same physical ship is slot 1 in one branch and slot 2 in another. Naming ships ЗЕВ/ХОР/ПАСТЫРЬ/ИКРА requires an identity the representation deliberately does not have. RECOMMEND: assign the name at the moment of the kill, by length + kill order ("ХОР (3)" = first 3-hull killed). Never name a hull before it is determined. Fix the log format to match.

2. WHAT "СМЕСТИТЬСЯ" ACTUALLY DOES IS NEVER STATED. §5.3 offers a choice but never says which branch you move to — under the set model there is no destination, "сместиться" simply means "the MISS bucket is chosen". RECOMMEND: say that in the dialog copy verbatim ("уход = ваш флот остаётся в тех 41 208 ветвях, где там пусто"), and drop any implication of picking a destination. Also define "ПРИНЯТЬ УДАР": it must be a mass-weighted sample among the damaging buckets, for the same reason as B1(a) — the most-massive-damaging reading makes accepting a hit anti-optimally self-harming.

3. Ω=1 AS A LOSS WILL READ AS A BUG. You lose without a single ship being sunk. RECOMMEND: at own-Ω ≤ 20 the header switches to "ВАС ПОЧТИ НАШЛИ · ВЕТВЕЙ 14" with the number falling, and the loss card leads with one sentence saying explicitly that no shot was needed — being found in every reality *is* the death. Foreshadow it in the briefing too; one line.

4. RIFT COUNT IS A DIFFICULTY KNOB PRICED AT ZERO. 2/3/4 rifts moves Ω₀ by ~25% but K in the score formula depends only on level. RECOMMEND: lock rifts at 3 and delete the segment. Ω₀ already varies 1.71M–2.23M by seed, which is all the per-game freshness the mechanic needs, and one fewer start-screen option is one fewer thing to polish.

5. THE TORPEDO'S FAILURE MODE IS UNREACHABLE. §4.4 says a torpedo into a cell empty in all branches is wasted — but §4.5 already forbids firing at a proven-empty cell. RECOMMEND: delete the rule and the string "ПУСТОТА ВО ВСЕХ ВЕТВЯХ · ТОРПЕДА ПОТРАЧЕНА ВПУСТУЮ". The torpedo is unconditionally a scar. Simpler, truer, one less lie in the UI.

6. REPLAY FROM localStorage HAS NO COVER. Rebuilding both universes (~120 ms) plus replaying every action is ~400 ms with the B5 fixes — fine, but it must not be a blank frame. RECOMMEND: reuse the boot typewriter with the line "ВОССТАНОВЛЕНИЕ · ПРОИГРЫВАЮ 14 ХОДОВ", then the existing "ОХОТА ВОССТАНОВЛЕНА" toast.

7. GHOST RE-ROLL CADENCE IS UNSPECIFIED. The CSS boil is time-based but ghost *identity* is not defined as per-turn or per-frame. RECOMMEND: re-roll exactly once per turn, from fork('тени'). That is what makes the picture a statement about this turn rather than noise, and it keeps replays byte-identical.

8. THE BENCH GATE MEASURES THE WRONG MACHINE. "600 ms worst move" on the dev box says nothing about a phone. RECOMMEND: gate at 120 ms on the dev machine (the 600 ms phone budget ÷ 5) and additionally assert the per-config work statically — caisson and salvo must be 4 typed-array loads + 3 ops, no Map, no string, no allocation in the loop. That is a machine-independent invariant and it is exactly what B5 buys you.

9. TWO Ω COUNTERS, ONE OF WHICH THE PLAYER CANNOT INFLUENCE. Nothing the player does affects their own Ω except dodging. RECOMMEND: make declining a dodge ("ПРИНЯТЬ УДАР") the cheap-in-Ω option and say so numerically in the dialog — that turns the loss clock into a resource the player spends deliberately, which is the only thing making B4's race a decision rather than an outcome.
feasibility.scope_check:
FINISHABLE — but the line count is 30–40% light, not 2×, and the schedule is where it breaks, not the code.

Line estimates, adjusted: theme.css 720 → ~950 (two boards, five stacked ghost layers, seven cell states, three ceremony tiers, four reduced-motion guards; the reference needed 571 for one board and one ceremony). app.js 700 → ~900 (four verbs including a draggable 3×3 window selector, dodge dialog, three screens, replay). boards.js 420 → ~550. audio.js 430 → ~600 and it is fully greenfield — the reference has literally zero audio to copy, and it has no unit-testable output. universe.mjs 330 and duel.mjs 400 are honest; I built and verified the oracle core in one sitting, so Milestone 1 at one day is realistic. Realistic runtime ≈ 5 400–5 900; with tests and tooling ≈ 7 500. That is 1.2× the reference project's shipped size, built without a chess library or an engine handed to you for free.

The schedule is the lie, not the scope. Eight milestones × one day each, with Milestone 6 (audio) as the worst offender: a look-ahead scheduler, four collapse-driven voices, a state drone and twelve hand-synthesised effects, greenfield, untestable by assertion. That is 2–3 days. Add one day for the B1/B2/B4 rule revisions and the selfplay tuning they require. Honest total: 12–13 working days, not 8–9.

CUT FIRST, IN THIS ORDER:
1. The tier-2 decoration — scrambling digits and the chromatic split of the ghost layer. ~80 lines of fiddly CSS timing for an effect nobody will name. The flash, the square ring and the odometer drum carry tier 2 alone.
2. voice.js down to three barks per event instead of seven. The spec already names this as its first cut; take it up front, not under pressure.
3. THE ЗАЛП VERB ENTIRELY, if selfplay shows it dominating. It is the most expensive verb to build (window selector UI, multi-cell resolution, tuple log format, tuple animation) for the least distinct feeling — the caisson already owns "big information" and the torpedo owns "guaranteed damage". Cutting it removes a whole interaction mode and ~250 lines across three files.
4. scripts/bundle.mjs. Ship on the dev server first. Single-file packaging is a distribution nicety; it is not the game, and it is the one milestone whose failure costs nothing.

DO NOT CUT, and I agree with the spec here: СВЕРКА and ПОКАЗАТЬ ВЕТВЬ, the three-state fog, the odometer, the frozen-brane drone. Those four are the difference between "clever" and "trustworthy".

ONE ADDITION WORTH MORE THAN ANYTHING ON THE CUT LIST, ~40 lines: bind ПОКАЗАТЬ ВЕТВЬ to a key and make it available from turn 1. An opponent that steps out from under your shots is the most suspicious thing a game can show a player, and the single best answer is a button that instantly draws a concrete fleet consistent with every answer so far. Right now that button is buried at the end screen, which is exactly where it is no longer needed.

Finally, restate what survived the attack, because it is the reason this is REVISE and not REJECT: the 3 562 232 figure is exact and reproduced on this machine in 50 ms; 8×8 with 4/3/3/2 really is the largest board where the counter can be an integer for the whole game; the honesty proof is sound and I checked its key consequence (Σ buckets == Ω) against live data; termination needs no timer. The foundation is genuinely better than the reference project's. The rules layer on top of it has not been measured, and every one of B1–B4 is a thing the spec asserted and I falsified in under an hour of simulation. Run selfplay before Milestone 3, not after Milestone 2.

completeness.verdict: REVISE — but only mechanically. The core is verified and buildable; there are 8 blocking contradictions/omissions, and every one of them has a specific fix stated below. Nobody needs to wake the user.
completeness.blocking:
B1. ГОНКА ДВУХ СЧЁТЧИКОВ НЕ ЯВЛЯЕТСЯ ГОНКОЙ НА УРОВНЯХ 1–3. §5.1 gives the Leviathan exactly one ПРОМЕР per turn; levels 4–5 additionally get torpedoes/caissons. The player gets 3 salvos + 2 caissons + 2 torpedoes = 7 actions worth ~1.4–1.8 bits each against a probe's ~0.36. Ω₀ ≈ 1.85M ≈ 20.8 bits. The player's special ammo alone contributes roughly 10–11 of those 21 bits; the AI must extract all 21 at probe rate. The player finishes in roughly half the AI's turn count, so at the DEFAULT level ШТОРМ the player essentially cannot lose — which makes the player's own Ω, the shift charges, the shift dialog, the right-hand board and half the fiction decorative. This is the single biggest threat to "весело".
FIX: add `foeAmmo: { salvo, caisson, torpedo }` to gods.mjs as data for EVERY level, not just 4–5. Recommended: ЗЫБЬ {0,0,0} · ОТЛИВ {1,0,0} · ШТОРМ {2,1,1} · ВОРОНКА {3,2,2} · ЛЕВИАФАН {3,2,2}. Make scripts/selfplay.mjs print, per level, BOTH sides' turns-to-collapse distributions and the player win rate, and treat "ШТОРМ 55–65 %" as a build gate, not an aspiration. Do not fix this by nerfing the player's ammo first — the four verbs are the game.

B2. ПРОБЕЛ ЗАБИНЖЕН ДВАЖДЫ. Presentation says holding Space multiplies all ceremony timers by 0.25; any sane keyboard scheme also binds Space to "fire the armed verb". Direct collision, and the failure is silent (you fire while trying to skip an animation).
FIX: Space = fire/confirm. HOLD SHIFT = ×0.25 ceremony speed. Change the config-screen line to «УДЕРЖАНИЕ SHIFT УСКОРЯЕТ АНИМАЦИИ».

B3. ИСХОД «ПУСТОТА ВО ВСЕХ ВЕТВЯХ» НЕДОСТИЖИМ. §4.4 defines a wasted-torpedo outcome for a cell empty in every branch, but §4.5 forbids firing at exactly such a cell (it is already .void). The string «ПУСТОТА ВО ВСЕХ ВЕТВЯХ · ТОРПЕДА ПОТРАЧЕНА ВПУСТУЮ» is dead code, and dead UI strings are how a game acquires an unreachable bug report.
FIX: keep the §4.5 ban, delete the wasted-torpedo branch and its string. The torpedo then ALWAYS produces ШРАМ or КИЛЬ — which is also a cleaner promise and makes risk-mitigation 1(b) ("guaranteed hit in the first 90 seconds") unconditionally true.

B4. КОРТЕЖ ПОВТОРА НЕПОЛОН — СОХРАНЕНИЕ БУДЕТ РАСХОДИТЬСЯ. Engine says a replay is `{ сид, уровень, действия[] }`. That omits (a) the rift COUNT (a config-screen option: 2/3/4), and (b) the player's own shift decisions, which are interactive and not derivable from the seed. Restoring from localStorage would silently reconstruct a different game — the worst class of bug, exactly like the aliasing trap the spec already fears.
FIX: replay tuple = `{ v:1, seed, level, riftCount, actions:[], defenceChoices:[] }`, where every raised shift dialog appends 0/1. Add a selfplay/unit test: replay a recorded game and assert the protocol is byte-identical, including both Ω series.

B5. ЗАГРУЗОЧНАЯ ПЕЧАТЬ ЖЁСТКО ЗАШИТА. «РАЗЛОМОВ В БРАНЕ … 3 · ОСТАЛОСЬ 1 847 464» is per-seed and per-rift-count, and is not known until the universe is built (~118 ms for two).
FIX: that boot line prints «…» and waits for the worker, then types the real number. This converts the build latency into content instead of hiding it. Add a boot line for the oracle mode: «ОРАКУЛ ........................ ОТДЕЛЬНЫЙ ПОТОК» / «РАЗДЕЛЕНИЕ КАДРОВ» (risk #7 already demands the fallback; it needs a place to be announced).

B6. EMAX ИГРОКА НИГДЕ НЕ ЗАДАН. gods.mjs specifies Emax for the Leviathan only, yet §3.2 is applied to the player's fleet with "your charges" and the HUD shows «СМЕЩЕНИЕ ВЫ ●●○ · ОН ●○○». If the player inherits the level's Emax, then on ЗЫБЬ (Emax 1) the beginner is the most fragile side — inverted difficulty.
FIX: player Emax = max(3, godEmax) → 3/3/3/4/5 across the levels; regen identical (§3.3); both sides start full. Put it in gods.mjs as `playerEmax` so it is data, not a formula buried in duel.mjs.

B7. ОКНО 3×3 НА КРАЮ ДОСКИ НЕ ОПРЕДЕЛЕНО. Salvo, caisson and the aim reticle all use a 3×3 window; the spec never says whether the anchor may sit on file А or rank 1. This changes the caisson's key width (9 bits vs 4–6 bits) and therefore the partition code.
FIX: any cell may be the anchor; the window is the 3×3 centred on it, CLAMPED to the board (so a corner window is 2×2). The caisson key is the occupancy pattern over the cells actually inside the board AND not rift/void/already-pinned, i.e. a k-bit key with k ≤ 9. Corner caissons are weaker; that is legible and needs no explanation. Reject the alternative (restricting anchors to the inner 6×6) because it makes the edges feel broken.

B8. §3.2(b) ОТНИМАЕТ У ИГРОКА ВЫБОР, КОТОРЫЙ ЕМУ ОБЕЩАН. Rule (b) says: if the largest bucket is not МИМО, take it and spend nothing. Applied to the player's fleet that means the game silently accepts a hit — even a КИЛЬ — without ever raising the dialog, and even under the policy ВСЕГДА. It also makes «ТОЛЬКО ОТ СМЕРТЕЛЬНОГО» undefined ("смертельного" is never defined anywhere).
FIX: (b) applies to the Leviathan only. On the player's side the rule is: if an evasion branch exists AND a charge exists, the policy decides. Definitions: ВСЕГДА = evade whenever possible; ТОЛЬКО ОТ СМЕРТЕЛЬНОГО = evade only when the non-evasive answer would be КИЛЬ, or when it would drop your Ω below 5 % of its previous value; НИКОГДА = never. The dialog is raised per §5.3 (last charge, or an order-of-magnitude crossing) plus, additionally, whenever the answer would be КИЛЬ — because a silent КИЛЬ is the one event a player will never forgive not being asked about.
completeness.gaps:
ВВОД: МЫШЬ И КЛАВИАТУРА
G1. Verb arming model is unspecified. RECOMMEND: ПРОМЕР is always the armed default; one click on a legal enemy cell fires immediately, no confirmation ever (the game's pleasure is rhythm). ⌗/◈/✦ arm a mode; Esc or a second press disarms and returns to ПРОМЕР. Armed verb button gets `.on` styling identical to `.seg button.on`.
G2. Salvo interaction. RECOMMEND: on arming, the hovered cell anchors an amber 3×3 outline; click toggles individual cells inside it (2–5 allowed, illegal cells dimmed and unselectable); the anchor re-follows the pointer only while zero cells are selected, then locks. «▶ ОГОНЬ» button + Enter fire; «ОТМЕНИТЬ ЗАЛП» + Esc cancel. Caisson and torpedo need no sub-selection: one click fires.
G3. Full keyboard table (there is none). RECOMMEND: 1/2/3/4 = ПРОМЕР/ЗАЛП/КЕССОН/ТОРПЕДА · стрелки or WASD = move a cursor cell on the focused board · Space/Enter = fire or toggle · Esc = cancel verb → close overlay → close drawer (in that order) · Tab = switch focused board · В = ПОКАЗАТЬ ВЕТВЬ · Г = toggle ГИДРОФОН · ? = re-open briefing · Shift held = ×0.25 ceremony speed. Print this table on the config screen under a «КЛАВИШИ» disclosure.
G4. Hover/cursor readout is undefined. RECOMMEND: one HUD line «Е5 · ВОЗМОЖНО» / «НЕВОЗМОЖНО» / «ГВОЗДЬ» / «РАЗЛОМ» / «УЖЕ СТРЕЛЯЛИ». Never a percentage unless the heat-map wheel is on — a hover percentage would be the heat map through the back door.
G5. Is your own board clickable? RECOMMEND: read-only, hover gives the same readout, clicks are inert. Write it as an explicit rule so nobody later adds "fire at yourself".
G6. Board coordinates А Б В Г Д Е Ж З / 8…1 must be drawn: file letters under both boards, rank digits on the OUTER edge of each (left of the foe board, right of yours), 10 px --phosphor-faint, matching the reference's coordinate treatment.

ГЕОМЕТРИЯ, РЕСАЙЗ, ТЕЛЕФОН
G7. Column behaviour between 1100 px and 1300 px. RECOMMEND: `grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, var(--board-max)) minmax(280px, 1fr) minmax(240px, var(--board-max))` so boards shrink before the layout collapses.
G8. The odometer's hard-coded 34 px digit stride breaks on browser zoom and on the mobile type scale. RECOMMEND: `--digit-h` as a var, `line-height: 1`, and `translateY(calc(var(--v) * -1em))`. Zoom-proof, one line.
G9. Dither tiles are fixed 16 px data-URIs while cells scale. RECOMMEND: `background-size: 16px 16px; background-repeat: repeat` — the dither is a constant-density texture independent of board size. That is what a console would do; write the comment.
G10. Minimum viewport. RECOMMEND: floor 320×568. Below 700 px width, show ONE board at a time behind a segmented switcher «ВРАЖЕСКИЙ СЕКТОР | ВАШ СТРОЙ», auto-flipping to your own board when the Leviathan fires and back after 1.2 s. Both Ω counters stay in a sticky header — the counter is the game and must never scroll away.
G11. Touch. RECOMMEND: `touch-action: none` on both boards; tap = click; no hover-anchored window on touch — the first tap PLACES the salvo/caisson window, subsequent taps toggle, an explicit «ОГОНЬ» button confirms. Enforce a 32 px minimum cell, i.e. a 256 px minimum board.
G12. Protocol panel scrolling is unspecified while html/body are `overflow:hidden`. RECOMMEND: `.protocol { overflow-y:auto }`, auto-scroll to bottom only while the user has not scrolled up (sticky-bottom flag), newest line last, `═══ ХОД N ═══` separators as in the reference.

ЧИСЛА И РЕСУРСЫ
G13. State explicitly: ammo does NOT regenerate; only shift charges do.
G14. Regen parity is ambiguous ("каждый второй ход"). RECOMMEND: +1 to both sides at the END of every even-numbered turn, capped at Emax. Since both start full, the first regen only matters after a spend.
G15. Score term «40·(неизрасходованных боеприпасов)». RECOMMEND: total unspent items across all three types (0–7, or 0–10 on ЗЫБЬ). «120·(оставшихся зарядов смещения)» = your charge count at game end. Clamp the total at 0 — the formula goes negative past 33 turns; print «БАЛЛ 0 · СЛЕПЕЦ» rather than a negative number. A loss scores nothing: «БАЛЛ НЕ НАЧИСЛЯЕТСЯ».
G16. Seed / КОД РЕАЛЬНОСТИ round-trip. RECOMMEND: the code IS the seed — 4 lowercase base36 characters displayed as «лот-8814» and accepted verbatim in the input field; level and rift count live in their own segments and in the replay tuple. «СЕГОДНЯШНИЙ» = base36 of the LOCAL date YYYYMMDD, truncated to 4 chars.
G17. Rift validation. Already gated at >500 000; add asserts that each placement list stays non-empty and <256 (the byte-index assert the spec demands). My sampling says 3 rifts never drops below ~1.7M, so the gate will effectively never trip — keep it anyway as a tripwire on the rift generator.

ПЕРВЫЕ ДЕСЯТЬ СЕКУНД
G18. Briefing shown once or always? RECOMMEND: expanded on first ever run (localStorage flag), afterwards collapsed behind a «БРИФИНГ» button; «ПРИНЯТЬ РЕШЕНИЕ» sets the flag.
G19. There is no script for the seconds after «▶ ОПУСТИТЬ ЛОТ». RECOMMEND, and this is the most valuable thing to nail down: 0.0 s boards arrive by dither wipe (240 ms) and the ghosts begin boiling · 0.4 s both odometers roll UP from zero to Ω₀ (the only time in the game the counter increases — it reads as power-on) · 1.0 s «ХОД 1 · ВАШ ВЫСТРЕЛ» · 1.4 s voice line «ВОДА СЛУШАЕТ. СПРАШИВАЙТЕ.» · the ✦ ТОРПЕДА button pulses amber with the tooltip «ГАРАНТИРОВАННОЕ ПОПАДАНИЕ» until the player's first action. Risk mitigation 1(b) is currently a hope; this makes it a mechanism.
G20. The Leviathan's telegraphed target does not exist on turn 1 (§5.2 says he picks at the end of HIS turn). RECOMMEND: he picks and displays his turn-1 target at game start, so the amber reticle sits on your own board from the first second. That is the cheapest possible demonstration of "your fleet is in play too", which risk #9 names as the hardest thing to teach.

ПАУЗА, ФОКУС, ПРЕРЫВАНИЕ
G21. No pause is specified and none is needed (no clock), but tab-switching is. RECOMMEND: on `visibilitychange` hidden — suspend the AudioContext and set `body.paused { animation-play-state: paused }`; on visible — resume with no toast.
G22. THE LOAD-BEARING RULE THE SPEC IS MISSING: game state is applied at the START of a ceremony; animations are purely cosmetic and may be skipped, interrupted or fast-forwarded without affecting state. Never mutate the duel inside an `animationend` handler. Write this at the top of app.js the way the reference writes its "клиент намеренно ничего не решает сам" comment.
G23. Clicks during a ceremony. RECOMMEND: input locked from action-sent to ceremony-end (`boards.setLocked(true)`); queued clicks are discarded, never buffered.
G24. Shift-held ×0.25 must scale audio too or picture and sound desync. RECOMMEND: one module-level `CEREMONY.scale` consumed by both; audio durations use `max(0.5, scale)` so effects thin out rather than becoming clicks.

НЕЛЕГАЛЬНЫЙ ВВОД
G25. Refusals have text but no defined consequence or placement. RECOMMEND: toast + a 120 ms --alert border flash on the offending cell; a refusal never consumes the turn, the ammo, or the Leviathan's move. Missing strings to add: «ЗАЛП: КЛЕТКИ ДОЛЖНЫ БЫТЬ В ОДНОМ ОКНЕ 3×3» · «В ЗАЛПЕ НЕТ НИ ОДНОЙ ДОПУСТИМОЙ КЛЕТКИ» · «КЕССОН: В ОКНЕ НЕТ НЕРЕШЁННЫХ КЛЕТОК» · «ТОРПЕДЫ ЗАКОНЧИЛИСЬ» · «ДЕЙСТВИЕ УЖЕ ВЫПОЛНЯЕТСЯ».
G26. Caisson legality. RECOMMEND: legal iff the clamped window contains ≥1 cell that is not rift, not void and not already pinned; pinned and void cells are excluded from the pattern key (including them would create a degenerate single-bucket partition that costs a turn and yields zero bits — a trap for the player).
G27. THE MISSING LEMMA THAT CLOSES THE "STUCK PLAYER" CASE: if Ω > 1 then two surviving arrangements differ in some cell; every already-fired cell is agreed upon by all survivors; therefore that differing cell is neither fired-at nor void nor nail, so a legal ПРОМЕР always exists while the game is live. Put it in REPORT.md beside the termination proof — together they prove the game can neither deadlock nor run forever, which is exactly the flavour of honesty the first project trades on.

КОНЕЦ ПАРТИИ
G28. Your own voluntary shift can drive your Ω to 1 and lose the game to your own hand. RECOMMEND: allow it, do not block it, but the dialog must show the resulting number, and the loss card gains a dedicated line «ВЫ ОПРЕДЕЛИЛИ СЕБЯ САМИ». Blocking it would be paternalistic; hiding it would be dishonest; naming it is memorable.
G29. Victory can arrive with zero kills (pure deduction). The victory copy «Флот перед вами утоплен во всех ветвях» would then be false. RECOMMEND a copy branch: if kills < 4, print «Флот определён во всех ветвях. Добивание — формальность.»
G30. The §7.1 finishing salvo has no defined length. RECOMMEND: reveal the unique arrangement with a 240 ms dither wipe, then sink remaining hulls at 250 ms each, hard-capped at 1.1 s total, then the card. A four-hull ending at full level-3 ceremony would be 4.4 s of nothing.
G31. Ω=1 reached mid-salvo: the per-cell ceremony queue must drain before the end card. RECOMMEND: wait for the queue, capped at 2 s.

СОХРАНЕНИЕ
G32. Keys, versioning, corruption. RECOMMEND: ASCII keys (Cyrillic keys are legal but a needless compatibility bet) — `leviathan:save` holds the replay tuple from B4, `leviathan:settings` holds the drawer settings SEPARATELY so a discarded save does not reset the player's audio and motion preferences. Any parse error or `v` mismatch: silently discard, start fresh, never throw.
G33. Write timing. RECOMMEND: after each completed turn (player action + Leviathan reply), synchronously, ≤4 KB; never during a ceremony.
G34. Replay must run silent. RECOMMEND: a `silent` flag on the duel machine — no audio, no ceremonies, no voice lines; ~350 ms of compute; then render the current state and toast «ОХОТА ВОССТАНОВЛЕНА».
G35. A finished game in storage. RECOMMEND: keep it with `finished:true` so a reload re-opens the end card rather than dumping the player onto the config screen; «НОВАЯ ОХОТА» clears it.

ДОСТУПНОСТЬ
G36. --warp #a05cff dithered at 6/16 over --cell-a #0d1620 is very low contrast by design. The tri-state fog is currently hue-coded. RECOMMEND: keep the shape codes (void = 2×2 cross, nail = 4×4 rivet, possible = dither only) and add ONE drawer toggle «МЕТКИ ВЫСОКОГО КОНТРАСТА» that raises the dither level 6→10 and swaps --warp to #c9a0ff. Four lines, and it is the accessibility affordance the spec currently lacks.
G37. The dangerous new hue pair is amber (scar) vs red (erased branches) — adjacent hues, both meaning "something happened here". RECOMMEND a hard rule: scars are a persistent SOLID amber fill; erased-branch dust is red and TRANSIENT ONLY, never a persistent cell state, never in the same cell at the same time.
G38. No focus ring anywhere in the reference, and this game is keyboard-drivable. RECOMMEND global `:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--bone); outline-offset: 2px }`.
G39. Screen readers / automated checking. RECOMMEND `role="grid"` on boards with per-cell `aria-label="Е5 · ВОЗМОЖНО"`, `aria-live="polite"` on the last protocol line, and a plain-number `aria-label` on each odometer (which is otherwise a pile of spans). This also makes the milestone-3 and milestone-8 checks scriptable for free.
G40. Photosensitivity arithmetic is incomplete: four layers at 720 ms with 180 ms offsets means a luminance change every 180 ms — 5.5 Hz of change, not 1.4 Hz, even though each layer cycles at 1.4 Hz. RECOMMEND: verify the summed luminance of the four offset curves is near-constant (choose opacity ranges so the sum is flat), and add an independent drawer toggle «БЕЗ МЕРЦАНИЯ» that freezes all four layers at their sum — separate from `prefers-reduced-motion`, because a player can want stillness without having set an OS flag.

ДВИЖОК
G41. The worker protocol is not specified at all. RECOMMEND: `{id, cmd, args}` → `{id, ok, data}`; cmds `build | probe | salvo | caisson | torpedo | ghosts | audit`; every reply carries `{omega, delta, bits, fog: Uint8Array(64), nails, ghosts: 4×12 cells}` ≈ 300 bytes; one request in flight at a time, id-matched; a 2 s watchdog falls back to main-thread chunking and prints the honest boot line.
G42. Worker unavailability detection. RECOMMEND: fall back if `new Worker` throws OR the initial build exceeds 1.5 s. Announce the mode in the boot print, per B5.
G43. Ghost duplicates. RECOMMEND: sample 4 uniformly and independently every turn (as specified); dedupe ONLY when Ω ≤ 4, so you never show a false quadruple-brightness hull, and the genuine convergence at the end reads at full strength.
G44. «ПОКАЗАТЬ ВЕТВЬ» semantics. RECOMMEND: a fresh uniform sample from `fork('показ')` on every press, drawn as a solid outline for 3 s with the line «ОДНА ИЗ 214 880 · ОНА СОГЛАСНА СО ВСЕМИ ОТВЕТАМИ».

G46. Ship names vs canonical ordering: the two three-cell hulls are interchangeable under `idx3a < idx3b`, so "which one is ХОР" is undefined. RECOMMEND: name by canonical SLOT — slot 3a = ХОР, slot 3b = ПАСТЫРЬ. Arbitrary but consistent, and consistency is the only property the player can verify.

G49. Number formatting: a thin space U+2009 will not render predictably in Consolas and will break the monospace grid the whole aesthetic rests on. RECOMMEND U+00A0 plus `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, a fixed 7-digit reservation on the odometer so it never reflows as digits drop, and an actual visual check on Windows Consolas before committing to it.

The oracle — the thing that would sink the project if the numbers were wrong — is real, and its whole surface is one primitive (partition → chooseBucket → compact) with four thin key functions. Milestone 1 and 2 are ~900 lines and will land. After Milestone 2 the game is playable in a console, which is the correct shape for a project that must not fail late.

Where the estimate is soft: the presentation stack is audio.js 430 + counter.js 150 + voice.js 190 + three ceremony tiers + boards.js 420 + theme.css 720 ≈ 1 900 lines of pure craft, none of it reusable from the reference except the CRT layer, the palette block, the buttons and the sprite RLE. Hand-written WebAudio with a lookahead scheduler and a state-carrying drone is a day on its own and always overruns, because it is tuned by ear, not by test. Realistic total is 5 500–6 500 lines and 11–13 days.

CUT ORDER, most-cut-first, all of it presentation, none of it mechanics:
1. Ceremony tier 3 for КЕССОН and ТОРПЕДА — collapse them to tier 2. Keep tier 3 for КИЛЬ and the two endings only. Saves the frame-freeze/shake/burn plumbing for three of five events.
2. voice.js down to three lines per event instead of seven (the spec already names this as the first cut). Keep every ГОЛОС ГЛУБИНЫ line — four strings, disproportionate atmosphere.
3. Music voices: ship БАС + ПАД + ДРОН only. Drop ЛИД and ШИПЕНИЕ. The pad's detune→unison arc IS the musical idea; the lead is decoration and the hiss duplicates the pad's job. The frozen-brane drone is load-bearing and is never cut — it is the only state the player can hear.
4. The live demo boil behind the config card.
5. The second Ω bar (bits remaining) — the odometer plus the delta line already carry it.

NEVER CUT, in priority order: the exact counter and its odometer; the tri-state fog; the four-layer ghost sum (the hull emerging from the ghosts' agreement is the entire visual thesis and it costs almost nothing once the dither tiles exist); СВЕРКА at both endings; the frozen-brane drone; the shift dialog with real numbers. Those six are the game; everything else is finish.

ONE STRUCTURAL WARNING ON SEQUENCING: B1 (the fake race) is a BALANCE finding, and balance findings are only settled by scripts/selfplay.mjs, which lands in Milestone 2. Do not build Milestones 3–8 on top of an unverified race. Insert a gate after Milestone 2: selfplay must show the player losing a meaningful fraction of games at ШТОРМ and ВОРОНКА before a single pixel of ceremony is written.
